subject: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity discussion — isolation & SLA milestones
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Amelie Laurent <amelie@veridiantx.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh@veridiantx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity discussion — isolation & SLA milestones

Hi Amelie / Rajesh,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — this note is a short post-call synthesis so we have aligned next steps. Appreciate you walking us through Veridian's throughput profile and regulatory constraints. Below is my read of the key requirements and the proposed path forward. Please flag anything I missed.

Quick recap of pain & goals
- Isolation: workloads handling PHI must run in a tenant-isolated pool (no multi-tenant colocations).
- Predictable throughput: 95th percentile latency target ~120ms/token at 96k token/day sustained bursts.
- Cost visibility: billing per-token with commitment-based discounts; need a clear overage policy.
- Auditability: KMS/HSM integration and 90-day access to request-level logs.

Proposed commitment path (high level)
1) Technical alignment call (ops + infra) — to validate model memory / quantization plan and confirm GPU footprint (Ben + Grace). Target: this week.
2) Draft SLA & commercial terms — attach a first-pass SLA (see PDF). Includes uptime SLO, latency SLO, and fallback model tiers.
3) Proof-of-concept window (2 weeks) — dedicated pool with isolation and monitoring; we'll instrument cost/latency dashboards.
4) Commit & provisioning — reserve capacity with monthly billing band and burst policy.

Immediate asks
- From Veridian: a short sample of request size distribution (top-3 endpoints) and an expected peak QPS window.
- From Redwood: we will circulate the SLA draft and an isolation ops matrix (attached).

Next meeting proposal: Thu Jun 18, 10:30 AM PT — 30 minutes (ops + infra). I can send calendar invite if that works.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): redwood-dedicated-sla-draft.pdf (summary of SLOs / credits), isolation-ops-matrix.xlsx (ops responsibilities matrix)

From: Amelie Laurent <amelie@veridiantx.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@veridiantx.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity discussion — isolation & SLA milestones

Thanks Sofia — this is a helpful summary. A couple clarifications from our side:

- The PHI workload is isolated to two endpoints (inference and batch scoring); typical request sizes are short (avg ~400 tokens) but we have daily retraining/eval jobs that can push sequence lengths higher (~8k tokens).
- Peak: our internal experiments show spikes during model validation windows (approx 10–12 PM ET) where QPS can triple for 20–30 minutes.
- Compliance: we need explicit language around key rotation and log retention for 12 months, not 90 days — can Redwood accommodate that?

We can do Thu Jun 18 10:30 AM PT. I'll invite our infrastructure lead (Rajesh) to join the ops call.

— Amelie
Head of Platform Engineering
Veridian Therapeutics

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelie Laurent <amelie@veridiantx.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh@veridiantx.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity discussion — isolation & SLA milestones

Looping in some technical notes ahead of Thu's call (ops + infra). High-level feasibility and open items: 

Feasibility notes
- Isolation: we can provision a tenant-isolated dedicated pool per account with physical GPU partitioning and network ACLs; will validate on PoC cluster.
- Throughput: to hit 120ms/token at 400-token avg, we'll need a mix of A100-style nodes and quantized float16 runtimes; longer sequences (8k) will require KV cache tuning and may reduce the sustained QPS.

Open items
1) Log retention: Redwood platform supports extended retention, but 12 months requires a compliance add-on and small storage delta — I'll include estimates in the ops matrix.
2) Key management: KMS/HSM integration is standard; we need the customer's KMS endpoint + rotation window to draft contractual language.
3) Overages & burst policy: propose a monthly commit (baseline) + automatic burst with throttled fallbacks; need finance to sign off on the credit thresholds.

I've attached an operational matrix with roles/responsibilities and a short cost delta estimate (isolation-ops-matrix.xlsx). Grace — can you confirm the quantization recommendations and whether we should pilot 4-bit quantization for the POC?

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks for the quick turn, Ben. Amelie / Rajesh, confirmed items and immediate next steps below: 

Confirmed
- PoC window: 2 weeks of isolated pool provisioning (target start Mon Jun 22).
- SLA: Redwood will produce an updated draft reflecting 12-month log retention and KMS rotation terms by EOD Jun 17.
- Ops call: Thu Jun 18, 10:30 AM PT (calendar invite sent).

Action items
- Veridian: share sample request histogram and KMS endpoint no later than Fri Jun 19 (Amelie / Rajesh).
- Redwood: Ben & Grace to validate quantization path and GPU mix; Sofia to circulate updated SLA and cost delta.
- Finance touchpoint: Sofia will loop in Commercial Ops next week to finalize credit/overage thresholds.

If anything changes to timing, please let me know — otherwise we'll see you Thu.

Best,
